totalFinancialPosition:
The amount shown is indicative of the amount a customer may be able to use but may not be what should be available or is actually available.


The amount shown is indicative of the amount a customer may be able to use in their {productName} accounts added together. The amount shown may not be what should be available or is actually available.

This can be because, for example:
  • some transactions may not have updated the amount shown (e.g. reversals)
  • some transactions may have updated the amount shown but are not yet fully processed (e.g. pending transactions),
  • we may not process transactions at the time, on the day or in the order that they are made, or
  • some transactions may have been processed and updated the amount shown, but are later adjusted.
    • If a customer proceeds with a transaction when there may be insufficient funds, their account may go overdrawn or the transaction may be declined.

    *This amount is only viewable by coaches and not available to the customer in the app.

HLFXD01LOAN_BALANCE:
Loan Balance is indicative of the amount you owe.


It generally reflects money in or out but:
  • some transactions that have occurred may not have updated the amount shown; and
  • some transactions that have occurred may have updated the amount shown but are not yet processed (e.g. cheques deposited, funds transfers in) or are awaiting for bank decision (e.g. transactions which may be blocked or refused, accounts with blocks).
HLFXD01REDRAW_AMOUNT:
This is an indicative amount of how much you may be able to redraw at any time. It’s generally the total of all the payments made minus all the payments required to have been made, minus amounts that’ve already been redrawn.


Some or all of it may not be available right away, or in some circumstances, at all. There are a number of reasons for this.


You may not be able to redraw extra payments if:

  • You've paid us everything owing under this contract, or your Loan Balance is positive
  • You try to redraw using a method your Loan Account does not support
  • You have an overdue payment, or a Default has happened
  • If there is more than one borrower:
    • One of you has asked us that redraw be blocked or
    • One of you has asked us that both of you have to approve a redraw and the other borrower doesn't approve the redraw or
  • Transactions are delayed, blocked or not being processed for any reason.

See ‘Redraw’ and other terms in the ANZ Plus Home Loan T&Cs for more details.
